name: Magma Seam
description: Open a thin seam of magma under the foe and send a bright jet up through them.

name: Lava Lash
description: Crack a rope of lava through the air so it wraps and burns the target's guard arm.

name: Pumice Storm
description: Whirl a storm of light hot stone round the body that batters blows and strikers alike.

name: Cooling Shackle
description: Cool molten stone round the foe's body into a heavy shackle that locks it in place.

name: Pyroclastic Wrath
description: Hurl a roaring cloud of hot ash and stone that sweeps the front and burns all within it.

name: Molten Deluge
description: Pour a deluge of molten stone from above and bury the ground beneath a glowing flood.

name: Obsidian Lance
description: Cool a spear of black glass in the air and hurl it through the strongest guard.

name: Slagfall
description: Drop a huge mass of slag from overhead onto one target and pin them beneath it.

name: Eruption Lance
description: Drive a lance of erupting magma upward through the ground and the foe in a single thrust.

name: Volcanic Dominion
description: Make the ground tremble and glow under the user's will so foes cannot stand on it.

name: Basalt Sovereign
description: Armour the user in black stone over a core of molten fire that answers each blow with a crushing return.

name: Lava Edict
description: Decree the ground molten under the foes at a reach and weight that scale with the user's core.

name: Pyroclastic Doom
description: Raise a doom of ash and fire over an entire field of battle to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Lavafall Cataclysm
description: Pour a lavafall from the sky across a vast front that melts everything in reach to the tier's ceiling.
